description: This PHP file defines the class AOS_Quotes, which extends AOS_Quotes_sugar. It includes methods for saving quotes, handling ID initialization, and marking quotes as deleted within the SuiteCRM application, specifically for the Quotes module.

classes.name: AOS_Quotes
classes.description: Represents quotes in SuiteCRM, with overridden methods for saving and deleting quotes including additional logic for quote number assignment and line item handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the AOS_Quotes class, calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the quote, initializes quote number based on database value and configuration, handles duplicate and new ID cases, and saves associated line item groups.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks the quote and its line items as deleted.
